Food
Oct 2026 • Solo
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Excellent Food and Wonderful Service!

I had a wonderful dining experience at Hanoi Fusion Pub & Restaurant, located at 41 Hàng Nón Street in Hanoi’s Old Quarter.

The food was absolutely delicious, especially the fresh spring rolls with shrimp, which were fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, attentive, and professional, making me feel comfortable throughout my visit.

The atmosphere was pleasant and relaxing, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Hanoi who wants to enjoy authentic Vietnamese food and warm hospitality!

Thank you to the amazing staff for such a lovely experience. I will definitely come back again! 🇻🇳❤️

New restaurant, good location, tasty local delicacies, Engish speaking staff
Sep 2026 • Family
It's a new restaurant that opened earlier this year. The owner speaks fluent English and the waiters speak English well.
The menu offers a variety of tasty foods. Rather than ourselves choosing, we asked Tho (the owner) to choose local specialties for us. We were delighted. Everything was wonderful. They have local draft beer, too.
Prices are good.
It is near the lake tourist area, a short walk, so easy to go there.
